Archived 2026-08-28 as openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-28-auditoria-sombra-lead-capture-investigation. Investigation-only (no code changed), Subdomain 2 of the freemium-onboarding master plan. Question: does completing Auditoria Sombra leave a queryable lead trace before a discovery call is booked? Answer: depends on the layer — apps/backend's run_auditoria_sombra (wizard_service.py) is genuinely stateless (verified by direct reading + 3-way adversarial verification + independent reviewer re-check), but the real-world caller, the contexia-wizard Next.js app, DOES persist: Step8Diagnostico.tsx unconditionally calls its own /wizard/api/audit/execute route, which writes audit_result/audit_executed_at/status/lead_score to Supabase `leads` and fires an internal Resend notification. Net: no lead is silently lost today. Implication for Subdomain 5 (freemium-tenant-minimum-seed): don't build persistence that already exists — first confirm whether the freemium entry point is contexia-wizard (covered) or a new direct-backend surface (would need its own write path). Also flagged: CentinelaService.save_alerts() is never called by this flow (raw alerts never persisted, only the LLM-merged summary), and two unrelated features share the 'Auditoria Sombra' name in this repo (the GTM wizard vs. a tenant-facing PDF/HITL report generator) — Subdomain 3's plan-tier gating must not conflate them. Reviewed via reviewer subagent: CHANGES_REQUESTED (one wrong line-range citation, one missing footnote), both fixed, findings otherwise fully verified against live code. Full findings note: openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-28-auditoria-sombra-lead-capture-investigation/reports/2026-08-28-findings.md. No Stage 11 (nothing to deploy).
